Add a question, choose Slider, and set its range and step.

![SurveyStudio's Design screen with the slider rating selected and its settings panel outlined.](../../../docs/question-types/slider-editor.png){width=100%}

## What the respondent sees

![The slider rating as the respondent sees it.](../../../docs/question-types/slider-preview.png){width=90%}

## Settings

- **Minimum, maximum and step.** Set the range and how finely the respondent can place the handle.

## Best practices for research

Label both ends with what they mean. A slider that starts at a value records it as an answer, so check what was moved.

Reference: Dillman, D. A., Smyth, J. D., & Christian, L. M. (2014). *Internet, phone, mail, and mixed-mode surveys: The tailored design method* (4th ed.). Wiley.
